solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique after crossings); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Top item California put inside bread roll

indicators.note: something put inside goes within the outer piece, here the roll

parts.note: a bap is a soft British bread roll
an item is a thing, an object of some kind
CA is the postal abbreviation for California

explanation.surface: A recipe step: some top-quality Californian item is stuffed into a bread roll.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Top item' looks like one phrase, but only 'Top' defines. A BAP is a British soft bread roll, opened after its A.
explanation.definitionFit: A swimmer's rubber headgear is a kind of top, in the sense of something worn on the head.

clue.text: Sweets and drops the head confiscated outside class

indicators.note: outside says the first piece wraps round the second
having its head confiscated means the word loses its first letter

parts.note: drops as a noun means falls, as in waterfalls
a class is a sort or kind

explanation.surface: A teacher confiscates sweets and drops outside the classroom.
explanation.walkthrough: Liquorice Allsorts are a well-known British mixed sweet. 'drops' is a noun here, as in waterfalls, not the verb; 'the head confiscated' signals losing a first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Liquorice Allsorts are a popular British assortment of liquorice confectionery.

clue.text: Search for missing note in cabin

indicators.note: missing says a letter is taken away from the search word

parts.note: to search is to hunt

explanation.surface: Someone searches a cabin for a missing musical note.
explanation.definitionFit: A cabin is a small simple wooden shelter, much like a shack.

clue.text: One is unusually sound

indicators.note: unusually means the letters of the two words appear in an unusual order

explanation.surface: Someone is surprisingly healthy, sound in the sense of fit and well.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sound' reads as an adjective meaning healthy, but defines as a noun.
explanation.definitionFit: Any sound, especially a loud or unwanted one, is a din or racket.

clue.text: Remains mostly outside a capital city

indicators.note: outside says the shortened remains go round the a
mostly means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: remains, as of a dead animal, are a carcass

explanation.surface: Remains are found mostly outside a capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Caracas is the capital of Venezuela.

clue.text: Bill holds port back

indicators.note: the bill holds the port within its letters

parts.note: a bill is a poster stuck on a wall
Rio de Janeiro is a Brazilian port

explanation.surface: A restaurant bill withholds the port wine until later.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' looks like part of 'holds port back' but is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The rear, or hindquarters, of something is its posterior.

clue.text: Is unable to swing round

definitions.meaning: is unable means cannot, written with an apostrophe
to tilt or turn sharply, as a ship does when it changes heading

explanation.surface: Someone is unable to turn about.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is the contraction of cannot; the other is a verb for tilting or turning a vessel.

clue.text: Scours harbour — with nothing like a walrus to be seen?

definitions.text: with nothing like a walrus to be seen?

parts.note: scours means cleans thoroughly
a harbour is a haven for ships

explanation.surface: A port is scrubbed, with no walruses in sight.
explanation.walkthrough: The walrus here is the drooping walrus moustache, not the animal.
explanation.definitionFit: Having no facial hair at all means there is no walrus moustache to see.

clue.text: Young monk's drama over wrong habit

indicators.note: in a down clue, over puts the first piece above the second

parts.note: Noh, also spelt No, is classical Japanese drama
a vice is a bad or wrong habit

explanation.surface: A young monk stages a drama about a misplaced habit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'habit' suggests a monk's robe, but with 'wrong' it is a vice.
explanation.definitionFit: A probationer in a religious order, not yet having taken vows, is a beginner.

clue.text: Tailor is fool to hurry back of blazer

parts.note: a clot is a British word for a fool
hie is an old word meaning to hurry

indicators.note: the back of a word is its final letter

explanation.surface: A tailor rushes to finish the back of a blazer.
explanation.definitionFit: A tailor is a maker or seller of clothes.

clue.text: Move to avoid waltz's beginning during ball at court

indicators.note: during places the letter within the serve

parts.note: a serve is a ball struck to open play on a tennis court

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: At a court ball, someone dodges the start of a waltz.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ball at court' suggests a royal dance; it is a tennis serve.
explanation.definitionFit: To veer suddenly aside, so as not to hit something, is the motion meant.

clue.text: Create difficulty for philosopher endlessly cut by left

indicators.note: cut by means the shortened name is split open by the letter
endlessly means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: Thomas Hobbes was an English philosopher

explanation.surface: A philosopher is endlessly obstructed by the political left.
explanation.definitionFit: To hamper or impede someone, as if tying their legs, is to cause them difficulty.

clue.text: Wife's got in mostly fish supper for working partner

indicators.note: mostly means the final letter is dropped

parts.note: bream is a freshwater fish

indicators.note: the wife has got in, so the letter sits inside the rest

parts.note: supper is an evening meal, dinner
W is short for wife; the 's stands for has

explanation.surface: A wife has brought home a fish supper for her working partner.
explanation.definitionFit: The earner who supports a household is the one in work.

clue.text: Like Jersey sailors to kiss amorously?

parts.note: a ship's sailors are its crew
to neck is to kiss and cuddle

explanation.surface: Channel Islands sailors canoodling with each other.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jersey' looks like the island; it is a jumper, a knitted pullover.
explanation.definitionFit: A jersey is a pullover, often knitted with a round collar fitting close to the throat.

clue.text: Tilapia is freshest spit cooked

indicators.note: cooked suggests the letters are worked over into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: The freshest fish is cooked on a spit.
explanation.definitionFit: Tilapia from the Sea of Galilee is traditionally named after the apostle Peter.

clue.text: Vast human waste with any number devoted to luxury

parts.note: something vast is epic in scale
urea is a waste compound in urine
N stands for any number in algebra

explanation.surface: Vast amounts of waste are produced by people devoted to luxury.
explanation.definitionFit: A follower of refined pleasure, especially in food and drink, is a hedonist.

clue.text: One originating at Isle of Wight resort lacking second name

parts.note: at means in, as in at home

indicators.note: lacking second means the second of the two letters is taken out

parts.note: Ventnor is a seaside resort on the Isle of Wight

explanation.surface: Someone from a Ventnor resort is at a loss for a second name.
explanation.walkthrough: The Isle of Wight is an island off England's south coast. VENTNOR has two Ns; 'second' says which goes.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who devises a new device or process is one who originates it.

clue.text: Lawbreaking shot, perhaps before teeing off

indicators.note: before puts the first piece ahead of the second

parts.note: a shot of spirits is an example of a drink
teeing off in golf is driving the ball

explanation.surface: A golfer has a quick shot at the bar before teeing off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shot' looks like a golf stroke; it is a shot of spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: Driving with too much alcohol in the blood is a criminal offence.

clue.text: Peninsula and related port in the Med

parts.note: kin are relatives, so related people are kin
Tyre is an ancient port in Lebanon on the Mediterranean

explanation.surface: A peninsula and a nearby Mediterranean port are named together.
explanation.definitionFit: The Mull of Kintyre is the long peninsula in western Scotland.

clue.text: Case of veal is lost

indicators.note: lost suggests the letters have gone astray into a new order

explanation.surface: A case of veal has gone missing.
explanation.definitionFit: A small travelling bag or suitcase is a case for clothes.

clue.text: Withdrawn train cut for engineering work?

indicators.note: engineering work rebuilds things, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A train is withdrawn and services cut for railway engineering work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Withdrawn' reads as a cancelled train; it means reserved.
explanation.definitionFit: A reserved person who says little is uncommunicative.

clue.text: The sack around tavern is stored like wine

indicators.note: the sack goes around the tavern

parts.note: the sack is slang for bed, as in hit the sack
a tavern is an inn

explanation.surface: A sack of supplies is placed around the tavern where wine is kept.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The sack' suggests dismissal, which also means binned, but here it is bed.
explanation.definitionFit: Wine is laid down in racks called bins, so cellared wine is kept that way.

clue.text: City centre line

parts.note: a base is a centre of operations

explanation.surface: A line running through a city centre.
explanation.definitionFit: Basel is a Swiss city on the Rhine.

clue.text: Intended one for Resistance in country round Paris

indicators.note: one for resistance means one letter replaces the other

parts.note: France is the country surrounding Paris
R is the physics symbol for resistance
I is the roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A betrothed person joins the French Resistance around Paris.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Resistance' evokes the wartime French movement; it is just R.
explanation.definitionFit: A person's intended is the one they are engaged to marry.

clue.text: Some yeti seen roaming mountain valley

indicators.note: roaming suggests letters wandering into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Some yetis are spotted wandering through a mountain valley.
explanation.definitionFit: Yosemite is a famous glacial valley in California's Sierra Nevada.

clue.text: Perhaps cut down rye whiskey after second

indicators.note: after puts the first piece behind the second

parts.note: a mo is a brief moment, a second
Whiskey is W in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Someone downs a rye whiskey after a second one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rye whiskey' reads as a drink; 'rye' belongs to the definition, a crop.
explanation.definitionFit: To scythe a crop such as rye is to harvest it by cutting.

clue.text: Taunt rich setter, not well

indicators.note: not means the word is left out of the setter

parts.note: a jeweller sets precious stones

explanation.surface: A wealthy crossword setter who is unwell is mocked.
explanation.walkthrough: 'setter' looks like a crossword setter; it is a gem setter.
explanation.definitionFit: To mock or deride someone is to jibe at them.

clue.text: Want the French to cultivate tapestries?

parts.note: want means need
le is French for the
to work soil is to cultivate it

explanation.surface: French weavers who need to make tapestries.
explanation.definitionFit: Tapestries are an example of sewing or embroidery, hence the question mark.
